name: RC-B10-0112/2026 – § 3/2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on World Cancer Day
part_text: calls for a specific EU health programme, with a dedicated envelope, to protect public health and support patient and civil society participation in policymaking;
part_context: Regrets the fact that the 2028-2034 MFF does not have dedicated funding for health; calls for a specific EU health programme, with a dedicated envelope, to protect public health and support patient and civil society participation in policymaking; stresses that dedicated funding is necessary to deliver flagship EU health initiatives that require multiannual continuity and implementation capacity, such as Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan, which needs predictable investment to translate commitments into delivery in practice;
